hero.description: Aero Seeds is a trusted agriculture seed and biotech company dedicated to providing high-quality seeds for Indian farmers. We focus on productivity, crop performance, and farmer success.

products.title: Hybrid Maize 771
benefits: Highly suitable for sowing with a seed drill
First choice of farmers
Higher yield and better market price
Cobs do not open even after maturity
Strong stem and root system, so the crop does not lodge in wind
Versatile: suitable for both Kharif (June–July) and Rabi (October–November) seasons
Matures in 130–150 days in Rabi and 115–120 days in Kharif

products.title: Hybrid Maize 775
benefits: Highly suitable for sowing with a seed drill
Maximum yield
Versatile: suitable for both Kharif (June–July) and Rabi (October–November) seasons
Grain quality: kernels are bold, heavy, and yellow-orange in color, fetching good market prices
High shelling: 86–87% shelling percentage, meaning a high grain-to-cob ratio
Suitable for Central India, Bihar, Rajasthan, Gujarat, and Chhattisgarh
Fetches higher market price
Matures in 130–150 days in Rabi and 115–120 days in Kharif

products.title: Hybrid Maize 772
benefits: Highly suitable for sowing with a seed drill
Excellent germination capacity
Known for high yield per acre
High starch content, making it ideal for ethanol production
Strong disease resistance
Strong stem provides resistance against lodging
Uniform cobs filled up to the tip
Fetches higher market price

products.title: Soyabean Jwala-07
benefits: Maturity duration: 85 to 95 days
Seed rate: 40–45 kg per acre
Grain color: bright yellow
Average yield: 24 to 27 quintals per hectare
Special feature: resistant to diseases like yellow mosaic, charcoal rot, blight, bacterial diseases, and leaf spot
Excellent germination capacity
Suitable for timely sowing and adaptable to both high and low rainfall conditions

products.title: Soyabean Jwala-13
benefits: Maturity duration of only 85 to 92 days
Seed rate of just 35 to 40 kg per acre
Crop has a bright, shiny yellow color
Average yield of 25 to 28 quintals per hectare
Excellent disease resistance including mosaic, charcoal rot, blight, bacterial diseases, and leaf spot
Excellent germination capacity
Performs well even in heavy rainfall and dense soil conditions

products.title: Mustard
benefits: This hybrid variety has the potential to yield 12-14 quintals per acre.
This variety matures and is ready for harvest in approximately 120-130 days.
1 kg of seed is sufficient for sowing 1 acre of this variety.
Its pods are long, the grains are thick and heavy, and the grains are brownish-black in color.
Frost resistant

products.title: Chia Seeds
benefits: This variety gives a higher yield compared to normal Chia.
Maturity Period: It matures and becomes ready for harvest in approximately 110 to 120 days.
Sowing: 1 kg of seeds is sufficient for sowing in 1 acre.
Irrigation: It requires 4-5 light irrigations.
Yield: A production of approximately 6 quintals per acre can be obtained.
Frost Resistant: This variety is tolerant to frost conditions.
Disease Resistance: It is less susceptible to diseases.

products.title: Wheat Seeds AW21
benefits: High Yield: This variety is high-yielding, especially in Madhya Pradesh.
Better Grain Quality: It has superior grain quality, making it suitable for making rotis and other uses.
Disease Resistant: This variety is resistant to some common wheat diseases, helping farmers use fewer pesticides.
Enhanced Nutritional Value: This variety has better nutrition levels, making it more nutritious for human consumption.
Crop Duration: This variety matures in 115 to 120 days, making it an attractive option for farmers.
Lodging Resistance: The plant height is 90-95 cm, which prevents it from falling even in strong winds, keeping the yield safe.
Irrigation Requirement: This variety typically requires 3-4 irrigations.
Suitability: This variety is suitable for cultivation in states like Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Rajasthan, and Gujarat.
Seed Rate: A seed rate of 40-45 kg per acre is recommended.

products.title: Shiva
benefits: High Yield Potential: Shiva Chana can provide a yield of up to 39 quintals per hectare, which is equivalent to 15.5 quintals per acre.
Disease Resistance: This gram variety is resistant to diseases like Fusarium wilt.
Drought Tolerance: This variety can provide a good yield even in low water conditions.
Crop Duration: Ganpati 101 gram matures and is ready in 105-110 days.
Suitability: This variety is recommended for sowing in the Rabi season and under irrigated conditions.
Seed Rate: A seed rate of 30-35 kg per acre is recommended.

products.title: Megha
benefits: Disease Resistance: This variety is resistant to diseases like Yellow Mosaic Virus and Leaf Curl.
Production: Its yield potential is 12 to 20 quintals per hectare, which is higher compared to other varieties.
Crop Duration: This variety matures and is ready for harvest in 50 to 65 days.
Suitable Timing: It can be sown in Kharif, Summer, and Spring seasons.
Irrigation: Perform the first irrigation approximately 22 days after sowing, followed by two more irrigations at 15-day intervals.
Fertilizer: Use Urea, Single Super Phosphate (SSP), and Potash; apply fertilizers only after getting a soil test done.

process.heading: The Aeros Process
process.subHeading: From the field to your sowbag

steps.title: Sourced

hero.title: Built by farmers, for farmers.
hero.para-1: Aeros Seeds and Biotech Farmers Producer Company was founded with a clear purpose — to empower Indian farmers with high-quality seeds that deliver consistent performance and better yields. With deep roots in agriculture and years of experience, we understand the real challenges faced in the field.
hero.para-2: Our journey began with a vision to bridge the gap between advanced agricultural science and practical farming needs. Today, Aeros Seeds stands as a trusted name among farmers, dealers, and agri businesses, committed to quality, reliability, and long-term growth.

boxes.title: Quality First
boxes.description: We deliver carefully tested, high-quality seeds that ensure better germination and strong crop performance.

boxes.title: Farmer Focus
boxes.description: Every product is designed keeping farmers’ real needs, challenges, and profitability in mind.

boxes.title: Innovation
boxes.description: We combine modern agricultural techniques with practical field knowledge to improve productivity.

boxes.title: Trust & Reliability
boxes.description: We build long-term relationships with farmers and partners through honesty and consistent results.

ourVision.title: Our Vision
ourVision.para: To become one of India’s most trusted and preferred seed brands by delivering high-performance agricultural solutions that contribute to farmer success and sustainable growth.

ourMission.title: Our Mission
ourMission.para: To provide reliable, high-quality seeds that enhance crop productivity, improve farmer income, and support the future of Indian agriculture through innovation and dedication.

about.leadership: Led by Sandeep Patel, Aeros Seeds is driven by experience, dedication, and a deep understanding of agriculture.

footer.description: Quality-tested, high-germination seeds for Indian farms. Trusted by thousands of farmers across India for stronger yield and reliable harvests.
